KP05-P09-code.name: KP05-P09-code
KP05-P09-code.text:
```python
W=W0.copy(); H=H0.copy(); eps=1e-12
for k in range(80):
    H *= (W.T@X)/np.maximum(W.T@W@H,eps)
    W *= (X@H.T)/np.maximum(W@H@H.T,eps)
```
